title: Bound description size across repeated algebraic arithmetic
statement: After each repaired relative operation on the SAME fixed curve, normalize the near-unit complex oval coordinate, choose a cardinal rotation with real part>=1/2 using a slack comparison, dyadically round t=Im(u)/(1+Re(u)), and store the exact rational circle point((1-t^2)+2it)/(1+t^2). Its derivative bound<=2and fixed endpoints plus one square root give polynomial descriptive size. Do not carry the compositum of every algebraic root field or drift the exact initial D0. The accumulated direct error is capped by the inverse collar as well as output accuracy before physical decoding.
